message.content: According to the conversations recorded, Wolfgang Schulz suggested playing "Viva la Vida" by Coldplay at the jam session. This suggestion came from a conversation between Wolfgang and Li Hua, who agreed it would be a good choice for the set list. Specifically, Wolfgang expressed enthusiasm about the song, noting its popularity and potential to elevate their performance. He also mentioned that the energy of the song would be enjoyable to play on the drums. This aligns with the subsequent decision to add "Viva la Vida" to the set list, with Li Hua expressing excitement about the idea. Thus, it is clear that Wolfgang Schulz recommended the band learn and play "Viva la Vida" by Coldplay for the upcoming jam session.
